$jsonSchema.title: Review
$jsonSchema.description: One customer review: the sample reviews on the Reviews & Feedback page and anything submitted through its form.

role.description: Department or role. The form field is optional: blank in JavaScript is null here.

rating.description: Whole number 1-5. JavaScript reads it with Number(select.value).

recommend.description: Would recommend. feedback.js stores 'yes' / 'no'; here that is true / false.

isSample.description: true for the built-in sample reviews, false for ones a visitor submitted.

submittedAt.description: When it was submitted (JavaScript: new Date().toISOString()). null for sample reviews, which have no date.
